barrier_proposal: A pre-commit/CI lint pass (tools/audit/round9/D14/sweep/P2/enumerator.py --seams, generalising p2_facts.py's AST scan) that: (1) for each canonical predicate function named in a small registry (ThermalParameters.from_config, _dhw_enabled_from_config, wood_furnace_on, age_of, dt_util.parse_datetime, the fenced-call list in _apply_action/async_run_optimization, the entity-domain-from-target rule in pump_arbiter._write), extracts the CONF_ keys / attributes / thresholds it reads; (2) greps every other decision context in custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py for a read of the same key/attribute/threshold outside the predicate's own body; (3) fails the check when a new such read appears without a call to the canonical predicate or an explicit '# P2: sibling of <predicate>, reviewed <date>' annotation. This converts the class from 'periodically re-discovered by audit' to 'caught the day the second call site is added'. Estimated gate cost: under 2 seconds (pure AST + regex, no solver, no real HA loop), so it can run on every PR touching custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py, not just nightly.
